title: Prospective Engine×World Preference-Susceptibility Basis Reconstruction, Ferrers-Obstruction & Inversion-Witness Localization, TT-Use×Bound/Window×Reduction×Move-Ordering Search-State Mediation, Minimal Multidimensional Near-Equal Preference Representation, Cross-Engine Mechanism Transport & Evidence-Grounded Contrastive Explanation Experiment
founding_question: Why does an engine prefer one near-equal legal move over another beyond obvious tactical dominance?
p20_question: Which minimal engine-internal and chess-context mediator coordinates explain the prospectively observed engine×world inversion witnesses, and can they recover a transportable low-dimensional representation of near-equal preference survival without post-hoc scalar rescue?

authority_separation.p19_labels: Known case-selection / target labels. They are not new P20 outcomes.
authority_separation.p20_outcomes: Prospective search-state intervention responses acquired only after this constitution is sealed.
authority_separation.explanation_track: May compile only from typed evidence/provenance. Natural-language plausibility never promotes Track-A scientific authority.

development_support.use: mechanism localization and basis discovery only; not fresh confirmation

primary_contrast.definition: For adjacent engine pair (a,b), D_ab(x)=S_a(x)-S_b(x) on jointly-active P19 support labels. P19 inversion witnesses have D_ab=+1 or -1.
primary_contrast.intervention_response: For frozen search-state intervention z, recompute S_a^z,S_b^z under the exact P19 pair/chain support protocol and D_ab^z=S_a^z-S_b^z.

tt_semantic_use.tt_value_as_eval: typed inside EVAL family for class screen; separable only at exact-event localization

bound_window.role: typed mediator coordinates and exact-event stratification; no post-outcome threshold tuning

reduction.forbidden_proxy: Do not relabel generic depth loss, node count, or search exposure as LMR/reduction.

sequential_design.phase_A: Direct instrumentation/transparency gate. No P20 mediator outcomes.
sequential_design.phase_B: Prospective class-level interventions on all eligible P19 development rows using frozen arms.
sequential_design.phase_C: Exact-event localization only for family×engine×row cells satisfying the predeclared class-level positive rule.
sequential_design.phase_D: Minimal basis reconstruction under frozen complexity order and leave-one-source validation.
sequential_design.phase_E: Fresh holdout world confirmation using worlds disjoint from P18/P19/P20-development support.
sequential_design.adaptive_rule: Only the explicitly predeclared Phase-B→C gate may use earlier P20 outcomes. No new family, threshold, source, engine order, or target grammar may be added after Phase B opens.

phase_B_positive_rule.family_cell_positive: A class-level intervention changes at least one of: support label S_e, pairwise inversion contrast D_ab, frozen pair orientation, or root candidate fate on TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM while the exact pair remains legal.
phase_B_positive_rule.event_localization_admission: At least one primary obstruction witness or one matched non-obstruction control is family-cell positive.

basis_search.objective: smallest coordinate set that separates observed inversion vs non-inversion survival response patterns under leave-one-source validation
basis_search.strict_ceiling: Discovery adequacy is not confirmation. Fresh Phase-E contact is required for transport authority.
forbidden: soft violation tolerance chosen post hoc

fresh_confirmation.source_rule: world-disjoint from every P18/P19 development row and selected before P20 mediator outcomes are opened for those worlds
fresh_confirmation.exact_prediction_preseal: basis coordinates and predicted engine-pair contrast class must be frozen before holdout mediator intervention

explanation_contract.language_rule: Rendered explanation must be deterministically compiled from evidence graph plus verified chess facts; free generation is commentary only.

closure_logic.PASS: At least one minimal basis survives fresh holdout confirmation across frozen source/engine gates and materially explains at least one P19 Ferrers obstruction family.
closure_logic.PARTIAL_PASS: Development localization succeeds but fresh transport is mixed, or only one obstruction family transports.
closure_logic.FAIL: Prospectively measured mediator families fail to localize the inversion contrasts and fresh holdout supplies no basis support.
closure_logic.HOLD: Direct reduction instrumentation, support, exact-event addressability, or fresh-world positivity gates are not met.

claim_ceiling: P20 can identify search-state mediation of engine preference-survival contrasts under frozen computational regimes; it cannot infer human cognition or objective chess truth.
Known P19 inversion labels do not constitute fresh P20 confirmation.
A class-level effect is not an event-level causal mechanism until exact-event localization succeeds.
A minimal observed basis is not unique unless competing same-complexity bases are prospectively separated.
Reduction claims require direct reduction-decision instrumentation; proxies are forbidden.
